title: Reviewer roster entry
description: A person who verifies records against official sources. Kept in data/ rather than a database so that a declaration of interest is version-controlled, reviewed in a pull request and auditable line by line, exactly like the policy records themselves. A reviewer cannot be published without declaring their interests: `interests` is required, and "none" is a declaration, not an omission.

role.description: editor: may publish and unpublish records. reviewer: may mark a record verified. contributor: proposes changes only.

jurisdictions.description: Jurisdiction slugs this reviewer covers. Validated against data/jurisdictions.

interests.description: Declared conflicts of interest. Required. An entry of {"declaration": "None declared."} is how a reviewer states there are none; leaving the field out is not.

affects.description: Jurisdiction slugs the interest bears on, when it is narrower than the whole corpus.
